p: way of all the earth: I am ready to die as all men must.
charge of the LORD thy God: He shows how hard it is to govern and that no one can do it well except he obey God.
truth with all their heart and: Without hypocrisy.
shed the blood of war in: He shed his blood in time of peace, as if there had been war.
put the blood of war upon: He put the bloody sword into his sheath.
for so they came to me: That is, they dealt mercifully with me.
blood: Let him be punished with death, see 1Ki 2:46.
Comest thou peaceably: For she was afraid lest he would work treason against the king.
set their faces on me: In sign of their favour and consent.
bowed himself unto her: In token of reverence, and that others by his example might have her in greater honour.
kingdom also: Meaning, that if he would have granted Abishag, who was so dear to his father, he would later have aspired for the kingdom.
barest the ark of the Lord: When he fled before Absalom, 2Sa 15:24.
turned after Adonijah: He took Adonijah's part when he would have usurped the kingdom 1Ki 1:7.
altar: Thinking to be saved by the holiness of the place.
fall upon him: For it was lawful to take the wilful murderer from the altar, Ex 21:14.
head of Joab: Joab will be justly punished for the blood that he has cruelly shed.
priest did the king put in: And so took the office of high priest from the house of Eli, and restored it to the house of Phinehas.
servants of Shimei ran away unto: Thus God appoints the ways and means to bring his just judgments on the wicked.
Shimei went: His covetous mind moved him to risk his life, rather than to lose the worldly profit he had by his servants.
Thou knowest all the wickedness which: For though you would deny it, your own conscience accuses you for reviling and doing wrong to my father, 2Sa 16:5.
established in the hand of Solomon: Because all his enemies were destroyed.
